title: The training example, on 4-hour candles
description: The range the training drew, November 2021 on 4-hour Coinbase candles from the all-time high of the 10th. A downtrend at level 1: the downswing from 59,061 bounced to A, 60,761 (17 Nov 08:00), and the fall from there ran to B, 55,927 (19 Nov 00:00), the LL. The bounce made C at 58,686, a higher low G at 57,664 and F at 59,761 on Saturday 20 Nov 20:00: 79% of the way back to A. On 22 Nov 00:00 the close at 57,431 broke below G, a bearish market structure break one level finer, and that identified the range: 55,927 to 59,761, bands at 60,527 and 55,160 (the training's chart has 60,517 and 55,173 from another exchange). It held until 26 Nov 08:00, when 53,751 closed below the lower band; that close was also the downswing's break of structure. On hourly candles the same week has three lower lows between A and B, and no range here.
